waf_custom_rules.description: Block malicious security scanners, empty user agents on APIs, and common probe paths
waf_custom_rules.expression: (http.request.uri.path contains "/.env") or (http.request.uri.path contains "/.git") or (http.request.uri.path contains "/wp-admin") or (http.user_agent contains "sqlmap") or (http.user_agent contains "nikto")

waf_custom_rules.description: Enforce Managed Challenge on /admin and sensitive live-bridge auth routes outside trusted operator IPs
Rate-limit 2FA OTP endpoints to prevent brute-force & OTP enumeration
